split_caveat: The shipped train/test/validate boundaries are NOT used: 1,642 images are augmentations of 515 base scans, and 59 of test's 100 base scans (plus 91 of validate's 171) also appear in train. The split here is over base-scan groups, so no augmented copy of a validation scan is trained on. The previously reported 98.7% was measured against the leaking split, and additionally the class folders held 235 Roboflow-hashed copies of export images that the trainer also read.

pipeline.implemented_by: offline_cv.preprocess_for_model('mammography', img) - the same call inference.py makes, so training and inference cannot drift apart. Mammography had no pipeline configured at all before this.
